package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestTogetherListSelectorsEnableValidation(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultOverwriteOptions()
	opt.ExcludeGroups = []string{"sdk"}
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
	require.True(t, opt.Enabled)

	opt = DefaultOverwriteOptions()
	opt.OnlyGroups = []string{"ci"}
	require.NoError(t, opt.Validate())
	require.True(t, opt.Enabled)
}

func TestTogetherListSelectorsStillValidateValues(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultOverwriteOptions()
	opt.ExcludeGroups = []string{"unknown"}
	require.Error(t, opt.Validate())
}

func TestTogetherListSelectorSnapshotsPreserveEnabledState(t *testing.T) {
	opt := DefaultOverwriteOptions()
	opt.OnlyGroups = []string{"sdk"}
	snapshot := WithOverwriteOptions(opt.AsList()...)
	require.True(t, snapshot.Enabled)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"sdk"}, snapshot.OnlyGroups)
	require.NoError(t, snapshot.Validate())
}
